subject: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@solara.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway

Hi Marta,

Quick note ahead of the renewal conversation — I pulled together the usage and perf snapshots for Solara through May and a preliminary ROI recap. Key high-levels:

- Spend: ~1.15B tokens YTD, May spike +28% MoM driven by a new nightly batch for doc summarization.
- Token mix: 62% embeddings, 30% generation, 8% reranking — embeddings are the primary cost driver.
- Latency: median gen latency on current committed model has drifted from 210ms to 320ms for 512-token requests over the last 6 weeks; traces attached.
- Ops: CS has flagged a couple of transient timeouts during peak evening window (UTC), likely related to KV-cache pressure.

Attached: usage_report_May2026.csv, latency_traces_May2026.zip, and a short ROI deck with uplift/commit scenarios.

Goal for this thread: propose 2 renewal paths (1 conservative commit with burst; 1 aggressive commit + quantization pilot) and agree on date for decision so we can lock DGX pools. Can you confirm the date you and your procurement team prefer for signature? Also let us know if the latency regression is an immediate blocker — we can prioritize a short perf sprint.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

-----
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@solara.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Solara Renewals <renewals@solara.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway

Hi Avery — thanks for the data. A couple quick clarifying questions before we sync with procurement: 

1) Can you break out the embeddings spend by model variant (open-embed-v1 vs rdx-embed-quant)? I think the team accidentally captured some test traffic under a legacy key.
2) The latency numbers worry us. Is the regression tied to a model change or an infra shift? We saw increased user complaints last week.

Procurement would like to target a June 15th signature date if we can get a firm commitment and cost table. If the perf regression is a 48–72hr fix, we might still hit that.

Marta Ruiz
Head of ML Ops | Solara
marta@solara.com

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@solara.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway

Marta — quick note on options we can move quickly on from pricing/contract side: 

Option A — Conservative: 18% discount on a 12-month commit sized to current runrate + 20% headroom, standard SLA. Burst credits available at 2.5x for 30 days.
Option B — Growth: 28% discount for a 24-month commit, includes an initial quantization pilot (up to 3 models) and 99.95% latency SLO for production paths. We can scope the pilot as a timeboxed deliverable in SOW.

I attached a sample ratecard in the ROI deck but can produce a clean line-item table if procurement wants it. If they need June 15, we should get a signed LOI by June 4 to give legal and infra time.

-ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

-----
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@solara.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway

Marta — quick ops context from CS: 

- The two timeouts observed last week mapped to a specific autoscaler threshold in us-west-2; we already have a mitigation to increase the KV cache capacity and enable a guarded prefilling step during the nightly job. That should remove most of the tail latency spikes.
- We recommend the quantization pilot be scoped on a non-critical model path (a/b test) to validate quality and token reductions before wider rollout.
- I'll include runbook snippets and playbooks in Drive.

If you want, we can run a short perf test (48 hours) on your staging traffic to validate the fix before sign-off.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: runbook_prefill.md (Drive)

-----
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@solara.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 June 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway

Thanks all for the quick responses — summary and next steps: 

1) Rachel will run the 48-hour staging perf test and validate tail-latency improvement (target: reduce 95th pct from ~580ms to <300ms). Timeline: kickoff Wed 2 Jun, results by Fri 4 Jun.
2) Ben will publish a clean three-line pricing table for Option A/B plus an accelerated LOI template (deadline for LOI to hit legal: Fri 4 Jun).
3) Avery will prepare an internal Mutual Action Plan for signature by Solara on or before Tue 15 Jun, with primary checkpoints: perf validation, procurement LOI, SOW sketch for quantization pilot.

Marta — can you confirm the June 15th signature target and whether procurement wants the LOI in DocuSign? If yes, we’ll get the LOI draft over by Thu 3 Jun.

Avery

-----
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@solara.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 June 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal health — token mix, latency reconciliation, and uplift runway

Thanks — June 15 works as a target. Please send the LOI in DocuSign and the clean pricing table. We want the perf test results before LOI if possible, but procurement said they can provisionally move forward with LOI contingent on the perf pass. I'll review the ROI deck with our CFO tomorrow.

Also, on embeddings — I'll follow up separately with specifics on the legacy test keys; if you could split the May embeddings spend by key/model that will help clean the forecast.

Best,
Marta

Attachments referenced: renewal_ROI_deck_Solara.pdf
